_comment: Curated set of high-value Scryfall oracle tags to ingest. The full Tagger catalog is larger (~200+); this list focuses on tags that map directly to synergy concepts a deckbuilder cares about. To enumerate the canonical set, visit https://tagger.scryfall.com/ and scan the function/otag namespaces.
_format: Each entry is a Scryfall otag: namespace tag, lower-kebab-case. The ingest script will issue one paginated search per tag (`q=otag:<tag>`) and union the resulting cards into the per-card tag list.
